title: Add autonomous sprint summary generator
summary: Add a deterministic summary command over autonomy task records and transition events so long-running autonomous work can produce repeatable handoff and sprint evidence.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomous sessions produce task events but no compact operational summary.
Future agents cannot quickly distinguish integrated, active, blocked, and stale work.
Human reviewers must inspect raw JSONL transition history to understand what changed.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next hardening should publish sprint summaries as provenance-linked release artifacts.
